programmes.d: The reunion and the Mardi Gras madness continue! The girls' friendships are in jeopardy, Vinny gets sentimental, and the fans put the crew in the hot seat. It all goes down on part two of the reunion!

Since the Jersey Shore squad started taking family vacations, there have been 14 trips and a lifetime of memories. But throughout their adventures, they have always felt like something was missing. Now that's all about to change with one sweet return.
After 11 long years, the roommates are in for a shocking surprise as Sammi Sweetheart returns. Is she arriving with old baggage or a fresh start?

Sammi's making up for lost time, catching up with her old roomies, and figuring out the new dynamics of the group. Meanwhile, there's still a lot of unsettled business between Angelina, Deena, Jenni, and Nicole.
The squad heads to the mountains, but something strange in the sky disrupts their fun. Is this another classic prank or is their party finally coming to an end?
Pauly D has the meatballs melting down. A birthday party for Sammi has Vinny feeling a little salty. And a knock on the door has everyone on edge.

A surprise visitor shows up in the Poconos, the meatballs and Sammi devise a plan, and the roomies head to Atlantic City to watch Pauly spin. The trip has an unexpected twist when DNA results are revealed.
The guidos take over Atlantic City, and Pauly reconnects with an old friend. But the fun stops when Snooki's charcuterie party takes a turn for drama.
Mike starts an investigation on the whereabouts of Angelina's biological father and continues to stir the pot as the aftermath of the charcuterie party settles in.
Deena's day 1 agenda for the family fun trip includes family photos, margaritas, and a group dinner. Angelina and Mike have a sit down to talk things through.
Pauly breaks down Guido fashion, Vinny has an unexpected guest, Deena and Angelina try to clear the air. And, Sammi's boyfriend is coming to town to meet the roomies for the very first time.

Sammi's new man has arrived, and the roomies are putting him through the ringer. Plus, the gang goes for an adventure and heads to one of their favorite places, the strip club. Meanwhile, after two long years, an old roommate is preparing for a visit.
The Dirty Stay Outs take over the strip club, and Deena makes a new friend. For the first time in two years, Ronnie heads to Orlando to make amends.
Ronnie makes amends, and the roommates speak their piece. Meanwhile, the Angelina and Jenni dramers has Snooki stress eating and hightailing to the bar.
Mike continues to search for Angelina's dad, the dirty stay outs wreak havoc on Orlando, and the gang has a lot of theories to unpack.
MVP learn the truth about the earth, Sammi tries to be a dirty stay out, and Angelina needs answers from Mike.
The trip comes to an end. Will the Situation get out of Orlando alive? Will Sammi become a dirty stay out? And will Angelina find her father?

The family is back to redeem their biggest vacation fails and spill major shore secrets - which roommates dated back in the day?! Plus, a surprise guest leaves the meatballs kicking and screaming...it's the Jersey Shore: Family Vacation reunion!

The family reunion fun day continues! Margaritas are mixed, tables are flipped - but which roommate takes a twirl on the stripper pole? Find out on part two of the Jersey Shore: Family Vacation reunion!

Mike is throwing a party (for himself) and the roomies have no clue why. Meanwhile an emotional journey for Angelina finally comes to an end as she meets her biological father for the very first time.

While Mike throws a party for the release of his tell-all memoir, the situations reveal some shocking revelations that leave the gang speechless. Plus, Snooki night is upon us and Angelina's emotional reunion with her father might be too good to be true.

Snooki night turns into a girl's night that turns into Mike escaping to Vegas for a guy's night with MVP. Plus, Jenni & Sammi check in on Angelina and things get a little complicated. And the gang get an unexpected call from the Mayor of Atlantic City.

A getaway to Atlantic City gets sexy when Vinny strips, family dinner heats up when juicy secrets are revealed, and Angelina has some choice words for Sammi. Plus, the Mayor of Atlantic City honors the gang with their very own holiday.
The fam heads back to their old stomping grounds for a fun day of reminiscing, while Mike and Nicole engage in a very Jersey debate. Meanwhile, Angelina and Sammi aren't seeing eye to eye.
